acq_opportunity_links_acq_event_uq.name: acq_opportunity_links_acq_event_uq
acq_opportunity_links_acq_event_uq.where: "acquisition_opportunity_links"."acquisition_id" is not null and "acquisition_opportunity_links"."market_event_id" is not null

acq_opportunity_links_item_event_uq.name: acq_opportunity_links_item_event_uq
acq_opportunity_links_item_event_uq.where: "acquisition_opportunity_links"."inventory_item_id" is not null and "acquisition_opportunity_links"."market_event_id" is not null

inventory_items_grade_authority_check.name: inventory_items_grade_authority_check
inventory_items_grade_authority_check.value: ("inventory_items"."grade_label" is null) or ("inventory_items"."grading_authority" is not null)

counterparty_entity_roles_dates_check.name: counterparty_entity_roles_dates_check
counterparty_entity_roles_dates_check.value: "counterparty_entity_roles"."until_on" is null or "counterparty_entity_roles"."since_on" is null or "counterparty_entity_roles"."until_on" >= "counterparty_entity_roles"."since_on"

journal_entries_posted_completeness_chec.name: journal_entries_posted_completeness_check
journal_entries_posted_completeness_chec.value:
"journal_entries"."status" not in ('posted', 'reversed')
          or ("journal_entries"."entry_number" is not null
              and "journal_entries"."fiscal_period_id" is not null
              and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null)

posting_rule_versions_effective_range_ch.name: posting_rule_versions_effective_range_check
posting_rule_versions_effective_range_ch.value:
"posting_rule_versions"."effective_to" is null or "posting_rule_versions"."effective_from" is null
          or "posting_rule_versions"."effective_to" >= "posting_rule_versions"."effective_from"

posting_rule_versions_amount_range_check.name: posting_rule_versions_amount_range_check
posting_rule_versions_amount_range_check.value:
"posting_rule_versions"."match_max_amount" is null or "posting_rule_versions"."match_min_amount" is null
          or "posting_rule_versions"."match_max_amount" >= "posting_rule_versions"."match_min_amount"

projects_target_end_check.name: projects_target_end_check
projects_target_end_check.value: "projects"."target_end_on" is null or "projects"."starts_on" is null or "projects"."target_end_on" >= "projects"."starts_on"

time_entries_instant_order_check.name: time_entries_instant_order_check
time_entries_instant_order_check.value: "time_entries"."ended_at" is null or "time_entries"."started_at" is null or "time_entries"."ended_at" >= "time_entries"."started_at"

time_entries_currency_pair_check.name: time_entries_currency_pair_check
time_entries_currency_pair_check.value: ("time_entries"."currency" is null) = ("time_entries"."bill_rate_amount" is null and "time_entries"."cost_rate_amount" is null)

hosting_targets_addressable_check.name: hosting_targets_addressable_check
hosting_targets_addressable_check.value: "hosting_targets"."control_surface" = 'none' or "hosting_targets"."address_v4" is not null or "hosting_targets"."address_v6" is not null or "hosting_targets"."fronted_by_target_id" is not null

mail_domains_verified_implies_added_chec.name: mail_domains_verified_implies_added_check
mail_domains_verified_implies_added_chec.value: "mail_domains"."ownership_verified_at" is null or "mail_domains"."provider_added_at" is not null
